method.name: get_flag
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the given [param flag] is set. Uses the same flag enum as [InputEventSpatialTouch].

method.name: set_flag
method.description: Sets or clears the given [param flag]. Uses the same flag enum as [InputEventSpatialTouch].
